rows: Identify which API the actual route uses: FE, GT EU, Mekanism J, MI EU, GrandPower or an item-only adapter.
Check both the local face and the source/receiver face. Input/output terminology is relative to the Foundations buffer.
Verify the appropriate blockPorts or itemCharging scope, input/output gate, old compat master toggle and GT direction toggle.
Read the effective ratio and losses. An offer smaller than the conversion quantum cannot be rounded up.
For GT, check voltage, amperage, shared tick budget, battery tier and loss-adjusted packet cost.
Make space in the receiving buffer and test with a source that actually has stored power.
Use the Power button or /foundations power inspect while looking at a machine. Reports simulate readiness; they do not transfer energy or force-load chunks.

blocks.text: A disabled native-first adapter does not silently fall back to FE. A third-party source can still choose its own FE path if Calculator advertises it. This is a route-selection distinction, not a reason to add free conversion multipliers.
